name: funverse360-monorepo
description: FUNVERSE 360 — Play • Eat • Explore • Connect • Win (Full-Stack Hackathon Project)

scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
